import pandas as pd

def run(inputs: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> dict[str, pd.DataFrame]:
    dim_product = inputs["dim_product"].copy()
    stg_product = inputs["stg_product"].copy()
    
    # Sort staged records by product_id and update_date (chronological order)
    stg_product = stg_product.sort_values(
        by=["product_id", "update_date"],
        ascending=[True, True]
    ).reset_index(drop=True)
    
    # Initialize output with current dimension table
    result = dim_product.copy()
    
    # Get unique product IDs that have staged updates
    staged_product_ids = stg_product["product_id"].unique()
    
    # Process each staged product
    for product_id in staged_product_ids:
        # Get all staged records for this product in chronological order
        staged_records = stg_product[stg_product["product_id"] == product_id].sort_values(
            by="update_date"
        ).reset_index(drop=True)
        
        # Get current row(s) for this product from result
        current_rows = result[
            (result["product_id"] == product_id) & 
            (result["is_current"] == 1)
        ]
        
        # Process each staged record sequentially
        for _, staged_row in staged_records.iterrows():
            staged_category = staged_row["category"]
            staged_price_band = staged_row["price_band"]
            update_date = staged_row["update_date"]
            
            # Find current version
            current_versions = result[
                (result["product_id"] == product_id) & 
                (result["is_current"] == 1)
            ]
            
            if len(current_versions) == 0:
                # No current version exists - insert new current version
                new_row = {
                    "product_id": product_id,
                    "category": staged_category,
                    "price_band": staged_price_band,
                    "eff_start_date": update_date,
                    "eff_end_date": pd.NaT,
                    "is_current": 1
                }
                result = pd.concat([result, pd.DataFrame([new_row])], ignore_index=True)
            else:
                # Current version exists
                current_row = current_versions.iloc[0]
                current_category = current_row["category"]
                current_price_band = current_row["price_band"]
                
                # Check if tracked attributes changed (NULL vs non-NULL is a change)
                attributes_changed = (
                    (pd.isna(current_category) != pd.isna(staged_category)) or
                    (not pd.isna(current_category) and not pd.isna(staged_category) and current_category != staged_category) or
                    (pd.isna(current_price_band) != pd.isna(staged_price_band)) or
                    (not pd.isna(current_price_band) and not pd.isna(staged_price_band) and current_price_band != staged_price_band)
                )
                
                if attributes_changed:
                    # Expire current version
                    result.loc[
                        (result["product_id"] == product_id) & 
                        (result["is_current"] == 1),
                        ["eff_end_date", "is_current"]
                    ] = [update_date, 0]
                    
                    # Insert new current version
                    new_row = {
                        "product_id": product_id,
                        "category": staged_category,
                        "price_band": staged_price_band,
                        "eff_start_date": update_date,
                        "eff_end_date": pd.NaT,
                        "is_current": 1
                    }
                    result = pd.concat([result, pd.DataFrame([new_row])], ignore_index=True)
                # else: no change, no-op (unchanged record does not create new version)
    
    # Ensure correct data types
    result["product_id"] = result["product_id"].astype("int64")
    result["category"] = result["category"].astype("object")
    result["price_band"] = result["price_band"].astype("object")
    result["eff_start_date"] = pd.to_datetime(result["eff_start_date"], unit="us")
    result["eff_end_date"] = pd.to_datetime(result["eff_end_date"], unit="s", errors="coerce")
    result["is_current"] = result["is_current"].astype("int64")
    
    result = result.reset_index(drop=True)
    
    return {"dim_product_out": result}
